title: A week before the arrest
dek: An example of a reader-written story: four documents from the last week of June 2019, with short notes.
author: Inbox Atlas
body:
## The list

On June 30, 2019 Epstein emailed himself a list of names under the subject "list for bannon steve" [[029622]]. A week earlier his accountant had sent him Trump's financial disclosure with his own notes [[033369]].

## The last joke

On July 6 his lawyer promised "a hysterical wynn-trump issue that will make you laugh" [[031103]]. He was arrested that evening.

trail.n: July 6: the last email from a lawyer.
